refnamediv.refpurpose: Creation an instance of a co-simulation slave.

refsynopsisdiv.title: Calling Sequence
refsynopsisdiv.synopsis: instance = fmiInstantiateSlave(fmu) instance = fmiInstantiateSlave(fmu, timeout) instance = fmiInstantiateSlave(fmu, timeout, logger)

listitem.para: tlist, a FMI 1.0 co-simulation model that can be received by importFMU.
real scalar, communication timeout in milliseconds, 5 by default.
boolean, enable the FMU debug logging, %t by default.
tlist, an instance of the slave, see fmiInstantiateModel.

refsection.title: Description
refsection.para: fmiInstantiateSlave returns a new instance of a co-simulation slave. The slave is not visible and not interactive. This function must be called successfully, before any of the other FMI co-simulation functions can be called.
